title: Reseller Arcade
unlocks: seller badges, shop themes and reseller achievements

games.name: Profit or Loss?
games.how: Work out what this fictional flip really made after fees and postage.
games.teaches: Profit is what's left after every cost, not the sale price.

games.name: Scam Spotter
games.how: Legit buyer, or scam? Sort it before you get stung.
games.teaches: The common reseller scams, so you never fall for them.

games.name: Shipping Sprint
games.how: Pick the cheapest option that actually fits. Prices here are made up for the game.
games.teaches: Check size and weight before you price, or postage eats your profit.

games.name: Fee Frenzy
games.how: Quick fee maths on made-up fee rates. Beat the clock.
games.teaches: Fees are a percentage of every sale. Know them before you price.

games.name: Bargain Hunter
games.how: Which made-up listing is the real bargain, compared with recent sold prices?
games.teaches: Price from what things SOLD for, not what they're listed at.

games.name: HMRC Check
games.how: Quick questions on the UK tax rules for selling online.
games.teaches: Stay on the right side of HMRC as a reseller. UK rules, 2026.

games.name: Flip It Fast
games.how: Put the selling steps in the order that sells fastest.
games.teaches: Good process sells items faster and with fewer returns.

games.name: Reseller Word
games.how: Guess the five-letter reselling word in six tries.
games.teaches: The language of the resale game.
